content:
Hi all,

First post here. I ported flypitch, a Lean 3 port of the independence of the continuum hypothesis, from Lean 3 to Lean 4 using Claude. I am not a professional mathematician and looking for suggestions on how to evaluate whether the port is accurate / correct / valid. I pointed Codex at it for a hour, and it claimed to pass the initial sniff test.

https://github.com/ianklatzco/flypitch/tree/master/flypitch4

Thanks to https://sflean.group/ and @Boris Alexeev for the camaraderie.
